summary: Verified Data Pendidikan AI scanning end-to-end. 5/5 backend pytests passed (login, extract-ktm, extract-academic-record, bad format rejection 400, profile persistence). Playwright e2e on preview URL: demo student login, Pendaftaran>Pendidikan shows both AI cards, KTM upload -> AI auto-filled institusi='UNIVERSITAS NEGERI JAKARTA', nim='1234567890', jurusan='Ilmu Komputer', jenjang=S1; KRS upload -> also fills semester=5 and ipk=3.75. Both docs saved automatically and visible in Pendaftaran>Dokumen. Save Data Pendidikan works and all 6 fields persist after full page reload. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on Data Pendidikan.

minor.issue: Error message string in _extract_document says 'Format harus JPG, PNG, atau PDF.' but WEBP is actually allowed; message should mention WEBP for consistency with UI validator.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Sync backend error message in _extract_document to include WEBP: 'Format harus JPG, PNG, WEBP, atau PDF.'
critical_code_review_comments: EducationDocumentScan.jsx correctly gates OCR responses: shows 'Tersimpan' badge only when backend returns document; upload endpoint returns 502 if S3 save fails so no false success (matches earlier fix).

Backend _extract_document maps only whitelisted fields per doc type and normalises jenjang to {D3,D4,S1}; empty jenjang gracefully ignored - verified via UI (raw scan initially blank then correctly saved as 'S1' after user selection persisted).
PUT /profile stores education inside data blob; no dedicated endpoint - fine for MVP, but consider a scoped PATCH to avoid overwriting unrelated profile fields if multiple tabs edit concurrently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Education AI scanning is production-ready. data-testids in use: education-scan-ktm-card, education-scan-academic-card, education-scan-{ktm|academic}-file-input, education-scan-{ktm|academic}-preview, field-institusi/nim/jurusan/jenjang/semester/ipk, save-education-btn, registration-tab-pendidikan, registration-tab-dokumen, preview-document-{n}. Backend endpoints POST /api/profile/extract-ktm and /api/profile/extract-academic-record return {data, document}. Education data persists via PUT /api/profile inside profile.data.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in current iteration.
